Initial release of the Capterra Reviews API skill via Scavio.

- Search Capterra for B2B software and retrieve 20 ranked products per query.
- Get a full Capterra product profile, including all pricing details and the 25 most recent reviews.
- Page deeper into product reviews (in sets of 25), with full per-criterion scores and reviewer context.
- Three endpoints available: search, product, and reviews, each returning structured JSON.
- Clear setup instructions and usage guidelines, including parameter requirements and pagination rules.
